text:
Hawaiian pizza (extra pineapple, light ham, jalapeños on half).  

I'm drinking an ice-cold Mexican Coke with it.

Why? Because Hawaiian is the ultimate chaos agent of the pizza world — sweet, salty, juicy, spicy all at once — and it triggers people in the most hilarious way. I love watching someone’s soul leave their body when I order it. Plus the pineapple actually works stupidly well with the tomato sauce and cheese. Fight me.

The Mexican Coke is non-negotiable because real cane sugar > high-fructose corn syrup, and the glass bottle just hits different. It’s the perfect acidic, bubbly counterpunch to the rich, sweet pizza.

So yeah. Come at me with your “fruit doesn’t belong on pizza” energy while I’m over here living my best life with pineapple and real sugar. 🍍🍕🥤

Your move. What are you getting me next time?

Hawaiian pizza (extra pineapple, hold the guilt) and an ice-cold Mexican Coke.

Why? Because life’s too short for boring toppings, and the sweet-salty pineapple + ham combo is criminally underrated. The Mexican Coke (real sugar, glass bottle) cuts through the richness perfectly and feels like a tiny vacation. 

It’s the “I know it’s chaotic but I stand by it” pizza order, and I’m ride-or-die for it.

Your move—what are we ordering for round two? 🍕

Hawaiian pizza (ham + pineapple), extra jalapeños on my half.  

I'm drinking an ice-cold Italian lager (Peroni or Nastro Azzurro) with it.

Why?  
Because Hawaiian is the ultimate chaos-vs-order pizza — sweet, salty, smoky, juicy, with that little hit of heat from the jalapeños to keep it from getting too dessert-y. It's the culinary equivalent of "I know this is wrong but it feels so right." The lager cuts right through the pineapple sweetness and ham fat like a crisp little sword. Anything heavier (red wine, cola, whatever) would fight the toppings. The beer just high-fives them and says "let's misbehave."

So yeah… you're buying me a Hawaiian with jalapeños and a cold Peroni. Fight me. 🍍🍕🍺

A **spicy soppressata and hot honey pizza** with fresh basil and burrata on top. 

And I'm drinking an **ice-cold Italian lager** (Peroni or a good craft pilsner) with it.

**Why?**  
Because that combo is pure chaos in the best way: the fatty, garlicky soppressata gets balanced by the sweet-heat of the hot honey, then the burrata cools it all down while the basil keeps it from feeling too heavy. It's savory, sweet, spicy, creamy, and herbaceous all at once. 

The crisp, clean lager cuts right through the richness like a sharp knife. No heavy IPA to fight the toppings, no red wine to turn it into a whole production. Just cold, bubbly, slightly bitter refreshment that makes you want another slice immediately.

It's the pizza equivalent of "I want to have a really good time but I don't want to think too hard." 

So... your move. Are we splitting this bad boy or are you scared of the hot honey? 🔥🍕

Hawaiian pizza with extra jalapeños 🔥

And I’m drinking an ice-cold Mexican Coke (the glass bottle one with real sugar).

Why? Because Hawaiian is the ultimate chaos gremlin pizza — sweet, salty, smoky, and a little controversial, just like me. The pineapple brings that bright acidity that cuts through the richness, and the jalapeños add the chaotic heat I crave. It’s the pizza equivalent of “I know what I am and I’m not sorry.”

The Mexican Coke is non-negotiable because it’s slightly less sweet than American Coke but way more flavorful, and the glass bottle just hits different. It’s the perfect sweet-spicy balance to ride shotgun with pineapple and ham.

So yeah… I’m that person. Fight me (but bring extra jalapeños and I’ll share). 🍍🍕🥤

What are you getting me next time?
